text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in OOM + CUDA illegal memory access on serving-pool-5. 50+ failures in 3m. Auto-evac attempted.
jun-oncall: Seen it, taking. Can folks avoid changes to rollout? I'll start triage.
carol: I'm on logs. dmesg shows repeated: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` and `misaligned address` from nvproxy in kernel space. Node gpu-12 is flapping.
mike: Repro attempt on repro-gpu: ran load test, got: `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'` then kernel trace: ```[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU page fault (0x60): ... invalid read at 0x7fffa1234``` Looks like bad deviceaddr access, maybe during paging.
infra-eng: Cordon gpu-12 and drain serving pods. Start stable-fallback to model-compact on the router for customers pinned to default.
jun-oncall: cordoned and draining now. Patch rollout paused. Will kick single-node restart on gpu-12 after drain.
support-lee: Customer Ops, FYI: a handful of customers reported 500s and truncated responses starting ~00:03 UTC. Affected % ~8-12%, surfaced via retries. No data exfil or errors in request content.
carol: Quick dump from nvml: `gpu-12: ECC off, driver 525.60, kernel 5.15.0-100-generic`. Suspect driver/kernel mismatch with recent kernel preempt changes.
mike: Can we hotpatch the nvproxy? Risky. Prefer node restart + driver rebind first. If that fails, fallback to smaller model on remaining nodes.
jun-oncall: Doing rolling restart of container runtime on gpu-12 -> will rebind drivers. ETA ~2m.
incident-bot: oncall escalation: if errors persist past 10m, escalate to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
infra-eng: Restart done. Post-restart logs show fewer illegal accesses but one other node (gpu-15) started showing kernel pagewalk warnings.
carol: Started temporary routing policy: route 30% traffic to cpu-fallback, 70% to remaining gpus. Latency increased for cpu fallbacks but error rate dropped to <0.5%.
support-lee: Notifying top 3 affected customers with status update and mitigation steps.
mike: Saved core from gpu-12 at /var/crash/gpu-12-core-6112233344.tar.gz for later analysis.
jun-oncall: Ok wrapping up shift in 30m. Handing off to infra-eng for extended monitoring and eng-runtime for root cause.
infra-eng: Will run `git bisect` of recent kernel/nv driver merges and run reproducer under thread sanitizer and heavy paging. Assigning to @carol and @mike.
carol: Agreed. I'll open an incident ticket and include dump + dmesg + steps to repro. Postmortem planned.
support-lee: Posting customer communication draft to #incidents-updates, requesting approve.
jun-oncall: Thanks team. Follow-up: check memory pinning flags in our allocator; looks like unaligned deviceaddr access might be from delayed free race. Please include allocator owners in postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (routing + restarts). Monitoring for 60m. :white_check_mark:
